items.title: Minister Admits Nicotine Vape Liquid Scheduled Poison After Court Ruling
items.summary: Dr Dzul makes a major admission in Parliament, saying vape liquids containing nicotine are now subject to the Poisons Act 1952 (Act 366), due to the High Court verdict.
